$comment: Seed movement catalogue. Replace this list wholesale — nothing outside this file knows any movement name. Each entry: id (stable, kebab-case), name, category (strength | weightlifting | gymnastics | monostructural), aliases (optional, folded into search). Each entry also carries muscles: primary (what the movement is largely about) and secondary (worked, but not the point). These drive the body map and are a coach's judgement, not a citation — edit freely.
